customer-chris: Hey team — legal/SecOps are asking if we can guarantee EU-only processing for a 4-week POC. They want: customer-managed KMS (BYOK), a current sub-processor list, and proof that KV cache/requests won't leave EU. Also need pricing delta if we pin the customer to eu-west and block cross-region failover. Can we do this for a POC?

maria (Sales): @ajay @nina looping SE + Security. We can probably, but need specifics on required failover policy and whether Dedicated/Private is acceptable. cx wants minimal latency and no egress outside EU.

ajay (SE): Short answer: yes, but with options and tradeoffs. Hosted + regional pinning -> best TTV but limited BYOK. Dedicated (reserved GPU pool in eu-west) -> supports strict routing + some KMS integrations (we need a contract). Private -> full BYOK & on-prem KMS.

ajay (SE): Can you confirm: 1) Is any DR failover to non-EU allowed? 2) Do they require HSM-level key control or is cloud KMS fine? 3) Will they accept Dedicated with a contractual "no cross-region egress except for emergencies" clause?

customer-chris: 1) No, not allowed for production PII. For POC they'd accept controlled failover only with prior approval. 2) Prefer HSM-backed keys (YubiHSM/KMS-HSM). 3) Yes on the contractual clause but need it signed before go-live.

nina (Security): FYI: we support BYOK/HSM on Private today. For Dedicated we can do a customer-key integration but it requires a one-time engineering onboarding and a key-access addendum. Sub-processor list: link to our published list -> https://redwood.ai/legal/subprocessors (shareable). We'll need their SCC/DPA requirements and any export-control checks.

nina (Security): Also note: our runtime uses KV cache for prompt prefixes. For strict EU-only residency we can enable region-scoped caches and SNI-routing to eu-edge. That prevents KV replication to other regions.

ajay (SE): Config example we'd apply for strict routing (POC):

```
routing_policy:
  mode: pin
  region: eu-west-1
  fallback: none   # disables cross-region failover
  cache_scope: regional
  key_management: customer-provided (Private) or contract-required (Dedicated)
```

najay (SE): Endpoints for tests: `https://eu.api.redwood.example/v1/generate` (hosted pin) or `https://eu-dedicated.some-host/v1` (dedicated). For infra checks ask ops to add header `x-route-trace: eu-only` to verify egress paths. Example curl: 

```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -H "x-route-trace: eu-only" \ 
  -d '{"input":"test"}' https://eu.api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```

infra-deploy-bot: deploy created: eu-poc-route-2005 
status: routing-table updated -> pinned to eu-west-1, cache_scope=regional

maria (Sales): Pricing note (ballpark): pinning to dedicated eu pool (reserved) typically adds ~30-50% on top of hosted rates due to reserved capacity and capacity isolation. Private (self-hosted) is license + infra (order-of-magnitude higher ops cost). We can offer POC pricing (50% off) for 4 weeks if they commit to a 3-month evaluation afterwards. :thumbsup:

customer-chris: Can you send the detailed pricing and the key onboarding checklist? Also need a contact in Legal for the "no-failover" clause.

tom (Legal): I can draft the addendum. For "no-failover" we normally add an exception path for catastrophic recovery, but we can keep it locked behind "prior written approval" for the customer. I'll need the expected RPO/RTO and a list of approved on-call contacts.

ajay (SE): Proposed POC plan (high level):
- Week 0: Contract addendum signed, BYOK onboarding (if Dedicated/Private)
- Week 1: Provision eu-dedicated/pinned hosted test endpoints, enable regional cache, run trace tests
- Week 2: Run load/latency tests with sample PII dataset (anonymized)
- Week 3: Security review + sub-processor confirmation
- Week 4: Hand-off to ops + finalize pricing for production

maria (Sales): Meeting to sync: tomorrow 10:00 CET with cx, SE, Security, Legal. I'll send invite and POC checklist. Action items: @ajay send BYOK checklist, @nina share subprocessors link and KMS onboarding doc, @tom draft addendum.

customer-chris: Great — appreciate the fast turnaround. Please cc my SecOps: secops-anna@customerco.com on docs.

nina (Security): Uploaded BYOK checklist + KMS onboarding here: https://redwood.ai/support/byok-onboarding.pdf

maria (Sales): I'll email full POC proposal and pricing after the call. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
